blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s new spokesperson, Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., on Wednesday dismissed the claim that he was appointed to counter Palace Undersecretary Claire Castro, whom he described as “hard to take seriously.” “I have no intention of responding to every statement she makes because we only need to address criticisms that are serious,” he said in an ambush interview. “At times, with all due respect to Usec. Claire Castro, she is difficult to take seriously,” he added. READ: Lawyer Paolo Panelo appointed as VP Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Panelo made the remark when asked if his designation as […]...
